User.title: User Profile
User.description: User digital garden preferences, stats, and companion details

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth user ID

bio.description: A short motto or gardening intent statement

companionName.description: Name designation for the digital companion Mascot

companionType.description: Sproutling, Sage Pup, or Lumo Botanist

streakDays.description: Consecutive days of planting and notes taking

lastActiveDate.description: ISO date string of the last activity

theme.description: The digital garden visual theme selection

pushNotifications.description: Whether push alerts are configured and enabled

Seedling.title: Digital Garden Seedling
Seedling.description: A note, task, or thought planted in the digital garden

id.description: Unique identifier for this thought seedling

userId.description: The id of the owner gardener

title.description: The title or hook of the note

isTask.description: Whether this represents an actionable item

isCompleted.description: Whether the action element has been resolved

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the knowledge node

clonedFrom.description: Indicates if cloned from a starter template

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last fertilization / edits

ActivityLog.title: Gardener Real-time Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: A capture log of real-time actions performed by the gardener used for live analytics

actionText.description: Human descriptive tag of what was completed

xpGained.description: XP granted to companion for this action

/users/{userId}.description: Global user profiles and garden statistics

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Activity stream to power dashboard charts and real-time logs
